summary: Iteration 11 — FoeGuard farm-palette refresh + meal/treat card unification verified end-to-end. Tested: Forest Green navbar/footer (#2F4538), Cream page bg (#F5F3EF), ALL CAPS tabs (top-nav + category) + Barn Red active underline, Playfair Display H1 'BUILD YOUR BOX', removal of subscribe pill beside CHECKOUT, 8px-radius CHECKOUT button (Barn Red bg / Cream text), Subscribe & Save CHECKBOX (input type=checkbox, accent-color #C8102E) with toggle-driven details visibility, Tractor + CircleDot lucide icons on progress line, box-size tabs (6 lb no badge / 18-24-36 lb % OFF badges, active red), Playfair uppercase collection headers, unified meal/treat cards with always-on qty counter (Straw bg #E8DFC8 at 0, sage #7A9A7A at >0 for comfort), no-underline 'See more', click-anywhere-on-card navigation to /product/<id> and /treat/<id>, product detail wrapper max-width 1280px with 50/50 image/content grid (644px image @ 560px tall), product line tag pill with 6px radius and brand-collection colors (Comfort sage #7A9A7A, Primal Barn Red #C8102E, Royal Paws Harvest Gold #C9A84C), product h1 Playfair Display, Forest Green footer with Cream text. All 25 acceptance checks PASS.

top_nav_tabs.menu_uppercase_red: text-transform=uppercase, active color rgb(200,16,46) Barn Red PASS

subscribe_section.uncheck_hides_details: subscription-details removed after second click PASS

unified_meal_treat_cards.qty_pill_visible_when_zero: PASS — bg rgb(232,223,200) Straw, text '0', '−'/'+' visible
unified_meal_treat_cards.qty_after_plus: text='6lb', bg rgb(122,154,122) sage = #7A9A7A (comfort collection color) PASS

product_detail_cd_chicken.hero_grid_template_columns: 644.28px / 585.72px (50/50 desktop split, image left + content right) PASS

critical_code_review_comments: BoxBuilder.js inline styles are large (700+ lines, lots of inline style objects) — consider moving repeated tab/header styles into the existing App.css palette classes (.bb-header-title, .menu-top-nav button etc.) for DRY and theme-token consistency. Functionally fine.

ProductDetail.js still contains some hard-coded older colors that don't match the new farm palette: white card backgrounds (#FFFFFF, #FAF8F5) inside Farm-to-Bowl cards (line ~132) and Personalize section (#F0ECE6, line ~163), as well as the brand-icon circles (background #FFFFFF, line ~93). These secondary sections are below the hero and were not part of this iteration's spec, but they visually break the 'Remove pure white surfaces' global rule from the brief. Worth a follow-up pass.
Floating cart button on /product/<id> uses borderRadius: 10px and shadow rgba(136,48,47,...) — spec says 'Buttons max 8px radius' and 'Borders not shadows'. Tiny drift from the global rule.

ProductDetail.js helper components (FarmToBowlSection, PersonalizeSection, ProductFaqSection, CollapsibleSection) all carry stale Barlow-only headings; brief asks Playfair Display 600 for h1/h2/h3 globally. The product page hero h1 is correct, but Farm-to-Bowl h2 and FAQ h2 are still Barlow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 25 spec items in iteration 11 verified PASS on https://product-prefix.preview.emergentagent.com. Spot-checks programmatically captured backgroundColor + borderRadius + fontFamily + textTransform + lucide icon classnames (lucide-tractor, lucide-circle-dot) + grid template + pill colors per collection (Comfort #7A9A7A, Primal #C8102E, Royal #C9A84C) + click-to-navigate behavior on both product and treat cards. Non-blocking style drift remains on secondary sections of /product/<id> (Farm-to-Bowl white cards, Personalize section, FAQ container, floating cart 10px radius/shadow) — these are outside this iteration's checks but worth a follow-up pass to fully honor the 'no pure white, no shadows, max 8px radius, Playfair for h2/h3' global rules.
